title: Guessing About Now: The Future
goal: Use the future and the future perfect to guess about the present and about what has probably happened.

items: I can use the future to guess about the present, as in estará en casa.
I can use the future perfect to guess about what has already happened, as in habrá salido ya.
I can use the new words for working things out.
